mapper.select: SELECT r.resource_no, r.parent_resource_no, r.resource_name, r.resource_type, r.request_path, r.icon, r.sort_no, r.data_state FROM sys_resource r INNER JOIN sys_role_resource rr ON r.resource_no = rr.resource_no INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rr.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.data_state = '0' AND rr.data_state = '0' AND ur.data_state = '0' AND r.resource_type IN ('m', 'c') ORDER BY r.sort_no ASC

SELECT r.resource_no, r.parent_resource_no, r.resource_name, r.resource_type, r.request_path, r.label, r.sort_no, r.data_state FROM sys_resource r INNER JOIN sys_role_resource rr ON r.resource_no = rr.resource_no INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rr.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.data_state = '0' AND rr.data_state = '0' AND ur.data_state = '0' AND r.resource_type = 'r' ORDER BY r.sort_no ASC
